name: [Ontology MCP Endpoint] Query Tools
description: The Ontology MCP Endpoint provides a programmatic query surface that enables any AI agent or application to discover, explore, and reason over ontology data. Query tools support natural language search over ontology data, schema discovery through entity type and property listing, and structured entity/relationship traversal — giving developers and agents a single, consistent API to ask questions, retrieve answers, and build intelligent experiences grounded in your enterprise semantic layer.
